title: Improve unit tests to allow pseudo-render tests
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

Remove D3 mocking in unit tests to make pseudo-render unit tests possible.

* Takes a mermaid graph text as input
* Uses JSDOM to mock the browser environment and generate an SVG output
* Allows testing that SVG's structure
* All with the performance and simplicity of unit tests

> Caveat : those are not real rendering tests, the layout should be considered broken since JSDOM doesn't have a rendering engine.

Linked to #6627.

> [!NOTE]
> This PR is the first part of [the previous one](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/pull/6635).

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

Enable real black box testing rather than mocking things in unit tests.

Changesets that add features should be `minor` and those that fix bugs should be `patch`. Please prefix changeset messages with `feat:`, `fix:`, or `chore:`.
